verdict.rationale: Lovable's core interface is a chat panel. Users describe apps, data schemas and features in natural language, and can run project actions such as publish, deploy or finding a domain straight from chat, with follow-ups to steer work in progress; the same commands also work via Slack. Community users describe driving it through prompts, though their complaints concern output quality rather than the natural-language control itself. Missing for 10: evidence that every operation (e.g., billing/credit settings, direct SQL access) can be done by natural language, and independent hands-on corroboration of chat-driven project actions like deploy and domain purchase.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you describe what you want in the chat panel on the left, and you watch your app take shape in the preview on the right
you can also ask Lovable to run project actions from chat, for example publish my app, deploy this project, ship it, or find me a domain for my bakery
Describe the data your app needs in chat, and Lovable creates the tables and schema for you.
Send a follow-up, a correction, or a new idea at any time to steer the work
Mention @Lovable in a channel or send it a direct message to create new projects, make changes to existing ones, and ask questions about the apps in your workspace
